# NPC Roster State

Maintained by `npcs`. Established by `sessions/` through Session 9. Logs win over this file. Statuses are as of the end of Session 9 (Neyavr 2, inferred).

Sections indicate current or last known location, not origin. A last sighting does not establish that someone stayed there.

## With the party at Tser Pool

| NPC | Status and location | Notes from the logs |
|---|---|---|
| Ireena Kolyana | Alive, with the party at Tser Pool | Was unconscious after Kolyan's death. The party was unsure whether she would turn, though the conditions were not met. Gave the party a silver bracelet and says she knows nothing about it. At the crossroads, Strahd spoke fondly to her and explained his punishment of the village. Won the Game of Stories and returned the players' wagers |
| Blue-tipped raven (Muriel Vinshaw; identity unknown to the party) | Last seen traveling with the party, perched on Ivan's shoulder | The party protected it during the strix attack, removed its silver barbs, and healed it |

## Village of Barovia and vicinity

| NPC | Status and location | Notes from the logs |
|---|---|---|
| Ismark Kolyanovich | Alive, at the mansion | Fought alone against a plague spreader and nearly fell, and Elga healed him. Asked the party to take Ireena to Vallaki. Gave Elga a copy of the Record of Lost and Missing |
| Kolyan Indirovich | Dead | Died on the night of the siege. The party cleaned the body and carried it to the church for burial. Had given the party a scroll |
| Bildrath | Alive, injured | Nearly died from the plague spreader's miasma. Agni gave him a healing potion. Parriwimple carried him away. Antagonized by the party, especially Ivan |
| Parriwimple | Alive, at the church and shop | Gave each party member a waterskin and Grim a daisy |
| Mary (Mad Mary) | Alive | Her daughter Gertruda ran away to Vallaki. Ismark organized a search |
| Father Donavich | Alive, at the church | Conversations with the party in Sessions 4 and 7. Reconciled with Doru. Is responsible for Doru. Suggested the abbey of St. Markovia in Krezk |
| Doru | Alive, vampire spawn in the Undercroft | Passed the blood test (Agni, then Grim). Will try animal blood. Ivan threatened to kill him if any incident happens. Mentioned only Strahd's heart when Grim asked about heartless people |
| Barovian scouts | Alive, near the bridge | Searching for Gertruda and the Langsten family. The party left them alone |

## Tser Pool and crossroads: last sightings

| NPC | Status and location | Notes from the logs |
|---|---|---|
| Madam Eva | Last seen at the crossroads for the reading; current location not logged | Gave the shared Tarokka reading and asked the party to buy a toy for Arabelle's nameday |
| Stanimir | Last seen at Tser Pool | Welcomed the party, invited them to Madam Eva's tent and the campfire, and told the Dancing Fire tale |
| Arturi Radanavich | Departed Tser Pool; current location not logged | Asked whether the party had met Van Richten; they said no. The party won his manuscript and did not learn of his curse |
| Strahd von Zarovich | Departed southwest from the River Ivlis Crossroads; current location not logged | Said he learned of the party from his foretelling and spies. Ivan used the name Boris and claimed to be a Barovian townsman; the party supported the story. Strahd said he would investigate and may suspect the lie |
| Escher | Last seen driving Strahd's carriage away from the crossroads | Ireena was shocked to see him as the driver. He came from the Vistani camp |

## Unknown, missing, or no fixed location

| NPC | Status and location | Notes from the logs |
|---|---|---|
| Eliza | Alive; current whereabouts unknown | At Tser Pool she heard the party claim they traveled in with the Vistani through the Mists. She followed them toward the crossroads, returned after being told to leave, and, after threats, swore on her ability to travel not to follow again. **DM only:** she is Strahd's spy; the party did not learn her loyalty. No subsequent report to Strahd is logged |
| Rahadin | Current location not logged | Appeared at the village square after the siege, raised the dead villagers and proclaimed. Congratulated Ismark. Sniffed Ivan and Agni. Spoke to Elga about her urn. Knew nothing of Grim's heart pouch |
| Gertruda | Missing; location unknown | The Barovian scouts are looking for her and the Langsten family |
| Rudolph van Richten | Absent | The party read a torn page of his book and found his cache in the Svalich Woods. Agni recognized the name. Ivan and Elga knew him as an author and monster hunter. When Arturi asked whether they had met Van Richten, the party said no |
| Stranger with a pet monkey | Unknown | Arrived in the village days before the rebellion (from villagers' talk) |
| Langsten family | Souls released into Elga's urn | The zombified family was restored by Elga's ritual. Elga learned about them |
